note: Export activity is factually confirmed, not merely declared: dated customs/B-L rows with destination, HS and BOL number exist, latest 2026-02-27, from Hyderabad Air Cargo (INHYD4) to Turkey, Indonesia, Pakistan, Bangladesh. IMPORTANT HS DISCREPANCY: declared HS codes in the batch (292249; 293214; 293359; 293399) do not match the actual recorded code 29420090 on every visible row; per project rule 3 this is NOT a rejection ground — the company stays in the base and the code should be corrected to the factual 29420090 (organic chemicals / bulk drug intermediates). Also note the batch industry claim 'Продукты питания и FMCG' (food & FMCG) is contradicted by the evidence: the goods are pharma APIs/intermediates (Nefopam HCl, Tapentadol HCl, Etoricoxib, Carbamazepine USP, pharmacopoeia-grade chemicals) — industry should be reclassified as pharma/chemicals. Legal-entity note: the batch name 'ARENE LIFE SCIENCES LIMITED' returned an empty ImportKey shell page, while 'ARENE LIFE SCIENCES PRIVATE LIMITED' returned the 662-record profile; the shipment data therefore belongs to the PRIVATE LIMITED entity, and a related 'ARENE LIFE SCIENCES (UNIT 3) PRIVATE LIMITED' also appears in supplier lists — entity identity between the claimed 'LIMITED' and the data-bearing 'PRIVATE LIMITED' is not proven from public sources.
